amended.step: An order CAN be deleted once placed, as well as cancelled. DELETE /api/order/customerOrders (operation OrderModule_DeleteOrdersByIds) removes orders by id, and the Admin orders list carries a Delete control both in the toolbar and in every row menu. Cancelling is the right choice when you want the document kept with an audit trail; deleting is available when you want the residue gone. Note that cancelling does NOT clear the shipment - see the entry on the cancellation cascade. Checked on platform 3.1007.27, Orders 3.1000.4.
